import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
P=[np.ones_like(x),x,v,x*x,v*v,x*v,x**3]
pn=['1','x','v','x2','v2','xv','x3']
def res_for(w):
    cols=[];nm=[]
    for f,n in zip(P,pn):
        cols.append(f); nm.append(n)
        cols.append(f*np.cos(w*t)); nm.append(n+'*c')
        cols.append(f*np.sin(w*t)); nm.append(n+'*s')
    B=np.column_stack(cols); c=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]; r=dv_dt-B@c
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dv_dt), nm, c
r0=minimize_scalar(lambda w: res_for(w)[0], bounds=(0.35,0.45), method='bounded')
print(r0.x, r0.fun)
s,nm,c=res_for(r0.x)
for n,cc in zip(nm,c): print(n, round(cc,4))
